title: साकेला नाचेर हुर्किएको मान्छेलाई पहिचानविरोधी बनाइयोः विशाल भट्टराई
content:
No ads found for this position ‎काठमाडौँ । कोशी प्रदेशको नामाकरणको सन्दर्भमा दिएको एक अभिव्यक्तिका कारण एमाले नेता विशाल भट्टराई अहिले पहिचानवादीको तारो बनिरहेका छन् । भट्टराईलाई पहिचान विरोधी भन्दै सामाजिक सञ्जालमा उनको तीव्र आलोचना भइरहेको छ । ‎ ‎कात्तिक १९ गते खोटाङको ओख्रेमा आयोजित कार्यक्रममा उनले प्रदेशको नाम एकपटक राखिसकेपछि परिवर्तन गर्नलाई फेरि संविधान चलाउने काम निकै जटिल हुने बताएका थिए । साथै हर्क साम्पाङ नेतृत्वको श्रम संस्कृति पार्टीसँग प्रदेशको नाम फेर्ने एजेन्डा नभएको र आजसम्म हर्कले प्रदेशबारे कुनै धारणा नराखेको समेत बताएका थिए । ‎ ‎उनले भनेका थिए, ‘अहिले कोशी भनेको साझा पहिचानको नाम हो, त्यो स्वीकार्नुपर्छ । यही कानुन र संविधानअन्तर्गत जाने हो भने प्रदेशको नामकरण भयो, भयो । अब कोशी भयो, भयो। अब कोशीबाट अर्को नाममा दायाँबायाँ हुनलाई संविधान चलाउनुपर्ने हुन्छ ।’ ‎ ‎भट्टराईको यस अभिव्यक्तिपछि पहिचानवादी तथा श्रम संस्कृति पार्टीका समर्थकहरू उत्तेजित बने । यही अभिव्यक्तिका कारण उनको आलोचना भइरहेको छ । तर, आफूलाई जसरी ‘पहिचान विरोधी’ भनेर लखेट्ने प्रयास भइरहेको छ, त्यो गलत रहेको भट्टराईको भनाई छ ‎ ‎आफू माझकिरातमा हुर्किएको, साकेला नाचेर आएको र पार्टीको लाइनभन्दा अलग उभिएर पनि पहिचानको पक्षमा बोल्दै आएको भट्टराईको दाबी छ । विगतमा आफूले टुँडिखेलबाटै कोसी प्रदेशको नाम कोसी किरात वा सगरमाथा किरात बनाउनुपर्छ भनेर बोलेको समेत उनले बताए । ‎ ‎भट्टराईले नेपालप्रेसलाई भने, ‘मैले कुनै पनि समुदाय लक्षित भएर बोलेकै थिएन । पार्टीभित्र पहिचानको पक्षमा सबैभन्दा बढी बोल्ने नेता हुँ । पार्टीको खोटाङ जिल्ला इन्चार्ज तथा सांसद हुँदा सबै पालिकाहरूको नामाकरण पहिचानको आधारमा राख्नलाई मैले पहल गरेको थिएँ, समर्थन गरेको थिएँ । मेरो घर छेउ खोटाङ बजारमा मैले नै बजेटको पहल गरेर रामप्रसाद राईको शालिक बनाइएको छ । अस्ति हर्क साम्पाङले त्यहाँ पुगेर माला लगाउनुभएछ ।’ ‎ ‎हिजोका दिनमा पहिचानको मुद्दा उठाउनेले नै कोसी प्रदेश नामाकरणका बेला जनतालाई धोका दिएको भट्टराईले बताए । तत्कालीन माओवादीले चर्को पहिचानको मुद्दालाई मुखर बनाए पनि अन्तिममा कोसी प्रदेशको पक्षमा भोट हालेर जनतामाथि घात गरेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‎ ‎अहिले किरात राई यायोख्खाले मात्र पहिचानको आधारमा नामाकरण हुनुपर्ने कुरा उठाइरहेको भट्टराईको भनाई छ । तर, यो एक सामाजिक संस्था मात्र भएकाले राजनीतिक दलले नै यो मुद्दालाई उठाउँदा प्रभावकारी हुने उनले बताए । साथै हर्कले पनि जातीय राजनीति गरिरहेको उनको भनाई छ । ‎ ‎भट्टराईले भने, ‘हर्क जीले पनि जातीय राजनीति नै गरेको देखिन्छ । यदि हर्क समर्थकहरूले मेरो आलोचना गर्नुभए जस्तो हो भने त श्रम संस्कृतिले प्रदेश नामाकरणको विषयलाई आफ्नो एजेन्डा कहिले बनायो रु हर्क जीले प्रदेश नामाकरणको विषयमाथि कहिले बोल्नुभयो रु बिनासित्ती मेरो भनाइलाई बंग्याएर अपव्याख्या गरियो । मैले समुदाय लक्षित अभिव्यक्ति दिएकै थिएन ।’ Kathmandu. UML leader Vishal Bhattarai is currently becoming a target of identity activists due to a statement he made regarding the naming of Koshi Province. Bhattarai is being sharply criticized on social media for being anti-identity. ‎ At a program organized in Okhra, Khotang on October 19, he said that it would be very complicated to use the constitution again to change the name of the province once it has been named. He also said that the Labor Culture Party led by Hark Sampang does not have an agenda to change the name of the province and that Hark has not expressed any opinion about the province till date. ‎ He had said, "Now Koshi is the name of a common identity, we must accept that. If we go by this law and constitution, the naming of the province has been done, it has been done. Now Koshi has been done, it has been done. Now we will have to use the constitution to go from Koshi to another name." ‎ Bhattarai's statement has angered supporters of the identity movement and the Labor Culture Party. He is being criticized for this statement. However, Bhattarai says that the attempt to label him as 'anti-identity' is wrong. ‎ Bhattarai claims that he grew up in the Kirat region, came from Sakela dance and has been speaking in favor of identity despite standing apart from the party line. He also said that in the past, he had spoken from Tundikhel that the name of the Koshi region should be changed to Koshi Kirat or Sagarmatha Kirat. ‎ Bhattarai told Nepal Press, "I have never spoken out against any community. I am the leader who speaks the most in favor of identity within the party. When I was the party's Khotang district in-charge and MP, I had taken the initiative and supported the naming of all municipalities based on identity. I myself have taken the initiative to build a statue of Ram Prasad Rai in Khotang Bazaar near my house with the budget. Yesterday, Hark Sampang went there and garlanded it." ‎ Bhattarai said that those who raised the issue of identity in the past betrayed the people during the naming of Kosi Province. He said that even though the then Maoists voiced the issue of identity, they ultimately betrayed the people by voting in favor of Kosi Province. ‎ Bhattarai said that currently only Kirat Rai Yayokhkha is raising the issue of naming based on identity. However, since it is only a social organization, it would be effective if the political party raised this issue. He also said that Hark is also doing caste politics. ‎ Bhattarai said, "It seems that Hark ji also engaged in caste politics. If it is as Hark supporters have criticized me, then when did the labor culture make the issue of naming the province its agenda? When did Hark ji speak on the issue of naming the province? My statement was twisted and misinterpreted without any hesitation. I did not make any statement targeting the community."

नाम कोसी किरात वा सगरमाथा किरात बनाउनुपर्छ भनेर बोलेको समेत उनले बताए । ‎ ‎भट्टराईले नेपालप्रेसलाई भने, ‘मैले कुनै पनि समुदाय लक्षित भएर बोलेकै थिएन । पार्टीभित्र पहिचानको पक्षमा सबैभन्दा बढी बोल्ने नेता हुँ । पार्टीको खोटाङ जिल्ला इन्चार्ज तथा सांसद हुँदा सबै पालिकाहरूको नामाकरण पहिचानको आधारमा राख्नलाई मैले पहल गरेको थिएँ, समर्थन गरेको थिएँ । मेरो घर छेउ खोटाङ बजारमा मैले नै बजेटको पहल गरेर रामप्रसाद राईको शालिक बनाइएको छ । अस्ति हर्क साम्पाङले त्यहाँ पुगेर माला लगाउनुभएछ ।’ ‎ ‎हिजोका दिनमा पहिचानको मुद्दा उठाउनेले नै कोसी प्रदेश नामाकरणका बेला जनतालाई धोका दिएको भट्टराईले बताए । तत्कालीन माओवादीले चर्को पहिचानको मुद्दालाई मुखर बनाए पनि अन्तिममा कोसी प्रदेशको पक्षमा भोट हालेर जनतामाथि घात गरेको उनको भनाइ छ । ‎ ‎अहिले किरात राई यायोख्खाले मात्र पहिचानको आधारमा नामाकरण हुनुपर्ने कुरा उठाइरहेको भट्टराईको भनाई छ । तर, यो एक सामाजिक संस्था मात्र भएकाले राजनीतिक दलले नै यो मुद्दालाई उठाउँदा प्रभावकारी हुने उनले बताए । साथै हर्कले पनि जातीय राजनीति गरिरहेको उनको भनाई छ । ‎ ‎भट्टराईले भने, ‘हर्क जीले पनि जातीय राजनीति नै गरेको देखिन्छ । यदि हर्क समर्थकहरूले मेरो आलोचना गर्नुभए जस्तो हो भने त श्रम संस्कृतिले प्रदेश नामाकरणको विषयलाई आफ्नो एजेन्डा कहिले बनायो रु हर्क जीले प्रदेश नामाकरणको विषयमाथि कहिले बोल्नुभयो रु बिनासित्ती मेरो भनाइलाई बंग्याएर अपव्याख्या गरियो । मैले समुदाय लक्षित अभिव्यक्ति दिएकै थिएन ।’ Kathmandu. UML leader Vishal Bhattarai is currently becoming a target of identity activists due to a statement he made regarding the naming of Koshi Province. Bhattarai is being sharply criticized on social media for being anti-identity. ‎ At a program organized in Okhra, Khotang on October 19, he said that it would be very complicated to use the constitution again to change the name of the province once it has been named. He also said that the Labor Culture Party led by Hark Sampang does not have an agenda to change the name of the province and that Hark has not expressed any opinion about the province till date. ‎ He had said, "Now Koshi is the name of a common identity, we must accept that. If we go by this law and constitution, the naming of the province has been done, it has been done. Now Koshi has been done, it has been done. Now we will have to use the constitution to go from Koshi to another name." ‎ Bhattarai's statement has angered supporters of the identity movement and the Labor Culture Party. He is being criticized for this statement. However, Bhattarai says that the attempt to label him as 'anti-identity' is wrong. ‎ Bhattarai claims that he grew up in the Kirat region, came from Sakela dance and has been speaking in favor of identity despite standing apart from the party line. He also said that in the past, he had spoken from Tundikhel that the name of the Koshi region should be changed to Koshi Kirat or Sagarmatha Kirat. ‎ Bhattarai told Nepal Press, "I have never spoken out against any community. I am the leader who speaks the most in favor of identity within the party. When I was the party's Khotang district in-charge and MP, I had taken the initiative and supported the naming of all municipalities based on identity. I myself have taken the initiative to build a statue of Ram Prasad Rai in Khotang Bazaar near my house with the budget. Yesterday, Hark Sampang went there and garlanded it." ‎ Bhattarai said that those who raised the issue of identity in the past betrayed the people during the naming of Kosi Province. He said that even though the then Maoists voiced the issue of identity, they ultimately betrayed the people by voting in favor of Kosi Province. ‎ Bhattarai said that currently only Kirat Rai Yayokhkha is raising the issue of naming based on identity. However, since it is only a social organization, it would be effective if the political party raised this issue. He also said that Hark is also doing caste politics. ‎ Bhattarai said, "It seems that Hark ji also engaged in caste politics. If it is as Hark supporters have criticized me, then when did the labor culture make the issue of naming the province its agenda? When did Hark ji speak on the issue of naming the province? My statement was twisted and misinterpreted without any hesitation. I did not make any statement targeting the community."

When I was the party's Khotang district in-charge and MP, I had taken the initiative and supported the naming of all municipalities based on identity. I myself have taken the initiative to build a statue of Ram Prasad Rai in Khotang Bazaar near my house with the budget. Yesterday, Hark Sampang went there and garlanded it." ‎ Bhattarai said that those who raised the issue of identity in the past betrayed the people during the naming of Kosi Province. He said that even though the then Maoists voiced the issue of identity, they ultimately betrayed the people by voting in favor of Kosi Province. ‎ Bhattarai said that currently only Kirat Rai Yayokhkha is raising the issue of naming based on identity. However, since it is only a social organization, it would be effective if the political party raised this issue. He also said that Hark is also doing caste politics. ‎ Bhattarai said, "It seems that Hark ji also engaged in caste politics. If it is as Hark supporters have criticized me, then when did the labor culture make the issue of naming the province its agenda? When did Hark ji speak on the issue of naming the province? My statement was twisted and misinterpreted without any hesitation. I did not make any statement targeting the community."
